description: This is a C# source file defining classes related to running load generator scenarios in an Orleans-based distributed testing environment. It includes parameter classes, a scenario runner class, and code to configure and run an Orleans client, set up benchmarks, and execute load generation tasks.

classes.name: ClientParameters
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for the client connection to the Orleans cluster, including ServiceId, ClusterId, and URIs for Azure storage resources.

classes.name: LoadGeneratorParameters
classes.description: Specifies parameters for the load generation such as number of workers, blocks per worker, requests per block, and duration.

classes.name: LoadGeneratorScenarioRunner`1
classes.description: A generic class responsible for running load generator scenarios, setting up Orleans client, registering benchmarks, and managing the load testing lifecycle.

methods.name: LoadGeneratorScenarioRunner`1:.ctor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scenario runner with a specific scenario and logger factory.

methods.name: LoadGeneratorScenarioRunner`1:Run
methods.description: Executes the load test scenario: configures Orleans client, registers benchmarks, warms up the generator, runs the load, and measures overall RPS.
